FN-MSXYI1H-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 322
Committee: Transportation, Utilities and Sponsor: Representative Steve Clouse
Infrastructure
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 01/30/2026
House Bill 322 as introduced would: (1) extend the sunset date of the Underground Prevention
Program to January 1, 2037; (2) allow the Underground Damage Prevention Authority to
contract with a third-party administrator for administrative support, instead of the Public Service
Commission; (3) specifically authorize grants, assessments, and civil penalties to be deposited
into the existing Underground Damage Prevention Fund; and (4) allow excess monies in the
Fund to be used for underground facility damage prevention.
